item.title: New York City Comptroller Defends Decision Not to Invest in Israeli Bonds
item.description: Mark Levine, a Jewish Democrat, said he based his decision on financial analysis, not politics.

item.title: Ukraine Resumes Strikes On Russian Refineries
item.description: Plus, Trump canceled plans to livestream the execution of the Fort Hood shooter, and the FBI is investigating suspicious mailings sent to elections offices.

item.title: With China Facing More Trade Barriers, It Can’t Afford to Lose Europe
item.description: Beijing’s concession on hybrid vehicles shows how much it needs the European market

item.title: The Weapons and Intel That Only the U.S. Can Give to Ukraine
item.description: Despite its homegrown alternatives to U.S. military support, Ukraine has no substitute for some American intelligence and systems, such as Starlink.

item.title: Ukraine Strikes Russian Refinery After Moscow Breaks Trump’s Energy Ceasefire
item.description: Lifted Starlink restrictions will enable Ukraine to resume midrange strikes and other military operations.

item.title: The Tiny Robot Designed to Solve a Massive Underground Crisis
item.description: Watch how this $9 million robotics project could revolutionize how we survey and protect our sewage systems.

item.title: Canada Factory Sales Recover in August With Increased Prices
item.description: Shipments increased 1.5% from the month before, marking a sixth rise in factory trade in the last seven months after a 0.3% dip in July.

item.title: Starlink Suspicions and a Frantic Warning: Inside Trump’s Turn on Zelensky
item.description: Limitations on Ukraine’s access to military-grade Starlink terminals sparked panic among its officials and several U.S. lawmakers.

item.title: Best High-Yield Savings Accounts of October 2026: Up to 5.00%
item.description: Beat average interest rates with one of these top high-yield savings accounts.

item.title: Eurozone Industrial Resilience Falters as Energy Shock Bites
item.description: The fall in activity compounds a tough few months for the industrial sector in the region.

item.title: A ‘Ludicrously Ugly’ Bridge Is Exhibit A That Britain Has Lost Its Mojo
item.description: During more than a decade of tinkering and planning on the drab 20-yard structure, China built the world’s highest bridge and Canada forged a river crossing to the U.S.

item.title: The Engineer Accused of Bugging OpenAI’s Top-Secret Conference Room
item.description: Abdulrahman Alfozan kept ties in Saudi Arabia while he rose in Silicon Valley, until federal agents accused him of hiding a recorder behind a conference-room television.

item.title: Asia’s Uneven Economic Resilience Faces Stress Tests, IMF Says
item.description: Asian economies have adapted to war-driven energy disruptions more effectively than anticipated, despite their heavy reliance on the Middle East for fuel.

item.title: The Far-Left Firebrand Who Wants to Upend France’s Politics—and Cancel Its Debt
item.description: Jean-Luc Mélenchon has seized on student demonstrations and transformed himself into a real contender for France’s highest office.

item.title: Ukraine Says New Limits on Starlink Are Disrupting Its Military Operations
item.description: Ukrainian officials say the restrictions imposed on the terminals have blunted their ability to attack Russian targets and intercept drones.

item.title: Saudi Airlines Rush to Save Scores of Planes From a War Zone
item.description: Deadly Houthi missile strikes have airlines racing to move billions worth of planes to safety.

item.title: The Space Force Showed Us Its Weapons Used in Iran and Venezuela
item.description: Space Force electromagnetic-warfare systems are playing a key role in U.S. military operations around the world. WSJ’s Shelby Holliday visited a base in Colorado to learn more.

item.title: Russia Detains Japanese Journalist on Espionage Charges
item.description: Tensions between Tokyo and Moscow have been rising since Russia invaded Ukraine.

item.title: Two Cargo Ships Sink Near Strait of Hormuz, as Iranian Attacks Increase
item.description: The strikes come as the U.S. military is successfully shepherding more oil through the strait.

item.title: Houthi Strike Hits Building at Saudi Aramco Headquarters
item.description: The attack follows strikes on Riyadh’s international airport and expands the conflict between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-backed militants.
